description: Default desktop permissions. The fs read/exists/stat/rename/remove set exists for file-backed projects: a save re-emits the whole .scriptio archive, so it is written to a sibling scratch file and renamed over the target (atomic swap instead of a truncated archive if the app dies mid-write), and every save first stats and re-reads the target to notice changes another program made to it. dialog:allow-open backs the in-app Open... and the Locate... recovery when a bound file has moved.
